instruct: A young adult woman with a smooth, slightly husky low voice — velvet storyteller timbre, slow measured pace, intimate as if speaking just to one listener late at night. A hint of knowing amusement under the calm. Precise consonants, long easy vowels. Never breathy, never bright.

text: Read it to me once — just once. Then close your eyes, and I'll show you what your story sounds like when the canyon gives it back.
